title: Environmental DNA (eDNA) Extraction with Modified Qiagen DNeasy Kit
author: Collin Closek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yrqfv5w
materials: Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit
Nucleic acids were extracted from the filters using the Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit with some modifications to the manufacturer’s protocol.

Ashed beads were added to sample filters tubes with subsequent bead beating steps as in Djurhuus et al., 2017, and then incubated at 56 °C overnight with 900 μl Buffer ATL and 100 μl Proteinase K (Qiagen).

steps.title: Prepare glass beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.5 mm and 0.1 mm glass beads (BioSpec Products) to a glass beaker, cover with tin foil, and ash at 500 °C for 5 hours.

steps.title: Aliquot and sterilize beads
steps.instruction: Distribute 0.75 g of each bead size into sterile 5 ml extraction tubes, then sterilize the tubes.

substeps.instruction: Place 0.75 g of 0.5 mm beads into a sterile 5 ml extraction tube; repeat for 0.1 mm beads.
Loosen the caps of the tubes, autoclave them, and subsequently UV‑treat for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add extraction blank
steps.instruction: For each set of extractions, include an additional empty tube containing beads to serve as an extraction blank.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL and ethanol
steps.instruction: Transfer bead‑free supernatant to a 2 ml tube and add Buffer AL and ethanol sequentially, vortexing briefly after each addition.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the bead‑free supernatant into a 2 ml tube.
Add 650 µl Buffer AL and vortex briefly.
Add an additional 650 µl molecular‑grade ethanol (96‑100 %) and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Load onto spin column
steps.instruction: Apply the mixture to a DNeasy mini spin column in three 650 µl aliquots, then follow the remaining steps of the DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit.

substeps.instruction: Load 650 µl of the mixture onto the mini spin column; repeat two more times for a total of three 650 µl applications.
Proceed with the remaining steps of the Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Dilute DNA for metabarcoding
steps.instruction: Dilute the purified DNA samples 1:10 before 12S rRNA gene amplicon and metabarcoding preparation.
